3.claim: Humans typically have 23 pairs of chromosomes in most cells.

summary_points: Humans possess a distinct genetic blueprint, which is defined by a specific number of chromosomes found within the nuclei of their cells.

Multiple reliable sources, including those dated as recently as October 5, 2026, consistently confirm that the vast majority of human cells, specifically somatic or typical body cells, contain 46 chromosomes.

These 46 chromosomes are organized into 23 pairs, comprising 22 pairs of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes, directly supporting the claim that humans typically have 23 pairs of chromosomes in most cells.

summary_points: The claim that the 1969 Moon landing was completely staged by NASA in a Nevada film studio and directed by Stanley Kubrick is a well-known and persistent conspiracy theory.

4.claim: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France.

summary_points: The Eiffel Tower is a world-famous wrought-iron lattice tower located on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France.
Constructed between 1887 and 1889 as the entrance arch for the 1889 World's Fair, it serves as the primary global symbol of both the city of Paris and France as a nation.
Official documentation, historical records, and ongoing global tourism confirm without any doubt that the Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France.

11.claim: Drinking silver nitrate or bleach cures diabetes and eliminates high blood sugar permanently.

summary_points: Drinking silver nitrate, bleach, or any industrial chemical is extremely toxic, dangerous, and completely ineffective as a treatment for diabetes or high blood sugar.

Health regulatory agencies, including the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and World Health Organization (WHO), have repeatedly warned the public against consuming bleach products (such as chlorine dioxide or sodium hypochlorite) or toxic silver salts, noting they can cause severe internal chemical burns, acute liver and kidney failure, life-threatening low blood pressure, and death.

Diabetes is a chronic metabolic condition managed through medically proven treatments, including insulin therapy, regular monitoring, and lifestyle modifications; there is no scientific basis or approved treatment involving the ingestion of corrosive chemicals to permanently eliminate high blood sugar.

13.claim: 5G mobile network towers directly emit biological COVID-19 viruses into the atmosphere.

summary_points: The claim that 5G mobile network towers directly emit biological COVID-19 viruses into the atmosphere is completely false and scientifically impossible.

5G technology operates by transmitting data via non-ionizing electromagnetic radio frequency waves, whereas SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) is a biological viral pathogen made of genetic material (RNA) enclosed in a protein envelope, which cannot be created or transmitted by radio signals.

Global public health organizations, including the World Health Organization (WHO), the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), and international telecommunications authorities, have repeatedly debunked conspiracies linking 5G infrastructure to the spread of COVID-19.

14.claim: Eating bananas with milk creates a toxic poison that causes sudden cardiac arrest.

summary_points: There is no scientific or medical evidence to support the claim that combining bananas and milk produces a toxic poison in the human body.

While traditional systems of medicine such as Ayurveda caution against combining milk and bananas due to beliefs about digestive heaviness, modern nutritional science confirms that both foods can be safely eaten together.
Banana milkshakes and smoothies are widely consumed global foods that provide standard dietary nutrients like potassium, calcium, and vitamins, and they do not cause sudden cardiac arrest.

15.claim: Scientists confirmed that the Earth is hollow and inhabited by an advanced civilization at the core.

summary_points: The claim that scientists confirmed the Earth is hollow and inhabited by an advanced civilization is entirely false; the Hollow Earth concept is a well-known pseudoscientific myth and science fiction trope.

Seismologists have mapped the interior structure of the Earth using the propagation of seismic waves generated by earthquakes, conclusively demonstrating that Earth is composed of a solid outer crust, a thick mantle, a liquid outer core, and a dense solid inner core.

Physical parameters such as Earth's total mass, density, and gravitational force contradict the possibility of a hollow structure, as a hollow shell could not sustain the mass or gravity observed on Earth.

16.claim: Microwaving an iPhone for 30 seconds activates a hidden feature that fully recharges its battery.

summary_points: The claim originates from a notorious 2014 internet hoax called 'Apple Wave', which falsely advertised that updating to iOS 8 unlocked a hidden microwave-charging capability.

Placing an iPhone or any electronic device inside a microwave oven causes immediate damage to internal circuits and the metal casing, generating sparks, destructive heat, and potentially causing the lithium-ion battery to explode or catch fire.

Apple has never produced an iPhone capable of being charged via microwave radiation, and both technology experts and emergency services explicitly warn against putting electronics into microwave ovens.

17.claim: The Great Wall of China is the only human-made structure visible from Mars with the naked eye.

summary_points: The claim that the Great Wall of China is visible from Mars with the naked eye is entirely false and physically impossible. From Mars, which is tens of millions of kilometers away, Earth appears only as a tiny point of light (a bright star-like dot) in the sky, making it impossible to resolve any surface features.

Even from Low Earth Orbit (roughly 300 to 400 kilometers above Earth), astronauts from NASA and China's space program have confirmed that the Great Wall is extremely difficult or impossible to see with the naked eye because it is narrow and made of local stone and dirt that blends into the surrounding landscape.
No human-made structures are visible to the naked eye from space beyond low orbit, including from the Moon or any other celestial body.

18.claim: Vaccines contain microscopic RFID tracking microchips manufactured by Bill Gates to control human minds.

summary_points: The claim that vaccines contain microscopic RFID microchips manufactured by Bill Gates for human mind control is a completely unfounded conspiracy theory with no scientific or factual basis.

Medical authorities, independent fact-checkers, and regulatory bodies worldwide have verified vaccine ingredients and confirmed that no vaccines contain microchips, tracking devices, or any electronic components.

This conspiracy theory stems from distorted misinterpretations of comments made by Bill Gates in 2020 regarding 'digital certificates' for tracking vaccination records, which referred to digital health registries, not physical microchip implants.

19.claim: Barack Obama was born in Kenya and forged his birth certificate to become US President.

summary_points: Barack Obama was born in Honolulu, Hawaii, on August 4, 1961, making him a natural-born United States citizen eligible for the presidency under Article II of the U.S. Constitution.

Official birth records, including contemporary birth announcements published in Hawaiian newspapers in August 1961 as well as both the short-form and official long-form birth certificates released by the Hawaii Department of Health, confirm his birthplace in Honolulu.

Claims alleging he was born in Kenya or forged his birth certificate are false conspiracy theories that have been thoroughly debunked by government officials, courts, and independent investigative journalists.
